name: starlight-builder-lab
description: Build and restore portable agent skills and packages with source-backed ecosystem research, worked examples and inspectable package checks.

interface.longDescription: Research agent ecosystems, define one useful workflow, generate a portable skills-only plugin, inspect its package and restore checksum-bound downloads into a fresh folder. Includes worked examples and adverse cases. Requires host file tools and Python 3.10 or later to run scripts. Structural checks do not prove workflow quality, host compatibility, publisher identity or directory approval. No billing, accounts, remote services or automatic installation or publishing are included.
defaultPrompt: Help me build and test one portable agent workflow.
